Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus: Per omnia saecula saeculorum. R. Amen.

rows.English: God, through your Son you have bestowed the fire of your radiance upon the faithful. Sanctify this new fire, and grant that through these paschal feasts we may be so inflamed with heavenly desires that, with pure minds, we may reach the feasts of everlasting radiance. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

Per eumdem Christum Dominum nostrum. R. Amen.
